notes.title: We participated in City Builder & Colony Sim Fest
notes.notes:
Hello, Creators!

We are very happy to announce that Pandora's Toy Box is participating in this Steam City Building and Colony Simulation Game Festival! I believe that under your guidance, you will be able to build this continent into a prosperous one!

Pandora's Toybox is a game combines simulation and Roguelike elements. Players will play as Epimetheus, creating and guiding human civilization on a randomly generated continent. 

Witness the growth from settlement to city-state, interact with different beliefs, guide mankind to become devout followers of Olympus, and use the power of the gods to create a civilization full of faith.

Wishlist and follow!
